query: Has the built-up area increased, decreased, or remained unchanged?

result.query: Has the built-up area increased, decreased, or remained unchanged?
result.text: built-up / man-made surface has remained essentially unchanged between 2023-01-01 and 2023-07-01: 5.0% of the scene at the earlier date versus 3.9% at the later date (change -1.05 percentage points, -15.5 ha), which does not clear the measurement noise floor. Caveats: Relative radiometric normalisation applied to the later acquisition (band0: gain 0.977, offset -33.912; band1: gain 0.983, offset -47.838; band2: gain 0.988, offset -54.625; band3: gain 0.995, offset -90.698, ...). Change Vector Analysis over NDVI, NDWI, MNDWI, NDBI, BRIGHTNESS; threshold 0.7770 (Otsu 0.6963, separability 0.69, noise floor 0.7770)
